categories.main_business_segments: Dynamic Holding Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and processing of printed circuit boards (PCBs), including multilayer boards, high-density interconnect (HDI) boards, thick copper boards, built-in copper high heat sinking boards, and high-frequency microwave boards. The company focuses on high-end applications such as AI servers, GPUs, ASICs, high-end switches, networking communication, automotive electronics including ADAS and smart cockpit systems, satellite communications, aerospace, and military sectors. It also engages in the design of microcomputers and peripheral equipment, integrated circuits and substrates, and import-export trading related to these products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including multilayer and high-layer count boards (up to 50 layers), HDI with any-layer technology, ultra-low loss materials, back drilling with minimal stub processes, embedded copper technology, and high thermal conductivity materials. It also develops high-frequency millimeter wave (mmWave) products for automotive radar and 5G communications, and heat dissipation solutions such as thick copper and copper paste. The production processes emphasize automation, intelligence, and smart manufacturing, with facilities certified under ISO standards and equipped for high-frequency, high-speed, and high-heat dissipation PCB applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Dynamic serves a diverse customer base across multiple industries including network communications, AI servers, automotive electronics (ADAS, electric vehicles), storage devices (SSD, memory modules), satellite communications, aerospace, medical devices, and consumer electronics. Major markets include data centers, high-speed networks, automotive millimeter-wave radars, and 5G telecom infrastructure. The company supports global customers with a focus on high-reliability and high-value-added PCB products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan, China (Kunshan and Huangshi plants), and Thailand (newly established plant). Its sales are global, with significant export revenue from China, Mexico, Korea, Malaysia, and other countries. The company is expanding production capacity in Southeast Asia to mitigate geopolitical risks and to serve international customers more effectively.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dynamic operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of PCBs which are essential components for electronic devices. It sources raw materials such as copper foil, substrates, and chemicals from upstream suppliers and delivers finished PCBs to downstream customers including OEMs and system integrators in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes sustainable development (ESG), smart manufacturing transformation, process precision upgrades, and profitability growth. R&D focuses on 5G high-frequency communication, AI server and networking products, automotive electronics including ADAS and millimeter-wave radar, Mini-LED display technologies, embedded active and passive components, and heat dissipation management. The company invests in advanced materials, process capabilities for high-layer count and thick copper boards, and autonomous antenna testing technologies. It also emphasizes collaboration with customers for early product design and innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Dynamic generates revenue primarily through the sale of PCB products and related manufacturing services. Revenue is derived from product sales to global customers across various industries. The company also recognizes investment income from its subsidiaries and affiliated companies. Pricing strategies consider volume discounts and are aligned with product quality and cost structures.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dynamic is positioned as a high-tech, high-quality PCB manufacturer focusing on advanced multilayer, HDI, and high-frequency boards. It competes in a market characterized by oversupply and intense price competition, especially in low-end products. The company differentiates itself through technological innovation, sustainable practices, and strong customer relationships. Taiwan holds an 11.8% market share globally, with China dominating at 56%, and Southeast Asia emerging as a key production base. Dynamic is expanding capacity in Southeast Asia to enhance competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Dynamic reported consolidated operating income of approximately NT$17.79 billion, a 13.19% increase from 2023, with net income of NT$1.08 billion, reflecting solid profitability. Total assets grew by 37.72% to NT$30.9 billion, driven by increased accounts receivable, inventory, and property, plant, and equipment investments, notably in new factory construction in Thailand. The company’s equity increased by 16.98% to NT$8.08 billion. R&D expenses rose to NT$733 million in 2024, supporting ongoing innovation. The company maintains a balanced dividend policy and has a strong focus on sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dynamic emphasizes delivering high-reliability, high-value-added PCB products tailored to advanced applications such as AI servers, 5G communications, automotive electronics, and aerospace. Its value proposition includes comprehensive product lines, one-stop solutions, early customer involvement in product design, and global technical support. The company integrates ESG principles into its operations, enhancing long-term stability and competitiveness. Its investments in automation, smart manufacturing, and sustainable practices further differentiate it in the competitive PCB industry.
